name: @comma/core-strategies
description: Official Build, Plan, and Chat harnesses for CommaAgents, with their subagents, plus legacy QA, maintenance, and conversation strategies.

build.description: Implement code changes, verify them, and hand back to you after each turn.

plan.description: Explore the codebase, settle decisions with you, and produce a decision-complete plan for Build.

chat.description: Talk things through, with codebase and web research handled by subagents.

verify.description: Subagent: independent review of a finished change.

plan-critic.description: Subagent: checks a plan against the codebase.

research-worker.description: Subagent: establishes one fact from the web.

qa.description: Review a change set and report evidence-backed findings.

reduce-complexity.description: Identify and reduce unnecessary implementation complexity.

talk.description: Answer questions with optional codebase and web investigation.

standardize.description: Coordinate standards-driven updates across a project.

standardize-worker.description: Internal worker used by the Standardize manager.
